data.narrative:
Aalo Atomics is a Series B nuclear energy company founded by Matt Loszak that has raised $300M+ to date. The broader Nuclear Energy sector comprises 3 public companies (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private peers including Oklo, X-Energy, Nano Nuclear Energy, Fuse Energy, and Type One Energy. However, the private peer set lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables with aligned valuation tiers—only 1 adjacent-stage datapoint exists—precluding a reliable peer-median analysis.

The valuation analysis therefore relies on stage-progression methodology, applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement to the $300M total raised proxy. This yields an implied valuation of $570M. The stage-progression approach is grounded in observed capital trajectory patterns within the venture-backed frontier tech segment, though it does not incorporate sector-specific fundamentals or comparable trading multiples.

The single-method triangulation supports a range of $484M to $656M, with a median point estimate of $570M. Key uncertainties include: (1) absence of true peer validation due to sparse comparable set; (2) reliance on capital raised as a valuation proxy rather than revenue or operational metrics; and (3) limited visibility into whether frontier nuclear companies command sector premiums or discounts relative to broader cleantech venture benchmarks. Additional comparable data or disclosure of operational progress would strengthen conviction in this range.
